modeling_decisions: Concept inspected: retain compact30degree cone, broad dry bowl and limited oxidized rim sectors. Simplify granular microtexture to deliberate small slope facets subordinate to cone shape; not large boulders. A shallow inner shoulder may echo constructional rim complexity but no precise Lassen double-rim clone. Build bowl and outer flank as one closed continuous surface, no overlaid crater disk. No snowy peak, dark painted fake cavity, smoke or glowing lava. Rim-floor relief stays obvious in clay/top.
